rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a place or vehicle that feels crowded or cramped.

example.english: This bus is so crowded I can't move.
example.jyutping: nei1 gaa3 baa1 si2 bik1 dou3 juk1 m4 dou2

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that there are many people present, without necessarily stressing lack of space.

example.english: The mall is crowded today; there are people everywhere.
example.traditional: 今日個商場人多，周圍都係人。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 go3 soeng1 coeng4 jan4 do1 zau1 wai4 dou1 hai6 jan4
